panels.description: Colorado logistics terminal: Roman submits Antarctic transport through CSG. Display clearly separates FALCON — FIELD SITE and NEXUS — COASTAL CAVE LABORATORY and reads TWO HOURS, WEATHER DEPENDENT. Leave upper area clear.
Roman signs CSG ANTARCTIC LOGISTICS / NEXUS ACCESS while his bonded TJ waits beside the terminal. Leave upper-left clear.
Tracked transport leaves Colorado; Roman sits behind the windshield with bonded TJ in an open padded case. Leave upper area clear.
Split route map shows Sitara and Nayah leaving Falcon while Roman’s route enters from another line; they converge only at NEXUS. Keep sites separate.
